digest.component_or_area: store ensure registry, marker cache management, git tracking cleanup
propositions: 119 */.archived and 126 */.write.lock files are tracked in the tickets branch but should not be, causing git status pollution and plan-review attestation failures due to strict head check violations

An idempotent ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers detects tracked marker files via git ls-files and removes them from the index with git rm --cached in batches, then commits once, leaving worktree copies intact

When peers merge the untrack commit, their worktree marker copies are deleted by git's tracked-unmodified file deletion, preserving correctness because list compilation already excludes archived tickets

The reducer self-heals missing .archived markers on the exclude-archived list path by re-materializing them via reducer.marker.write_marker when compiled state indicates archived but the marker file is absent
After running the ensure unit, git status is clean on the committing machine and idempotent re-runs produce zero commits
Archived tickets with regenerated markers are correctly excluded from default list output while include-archived lists bypass marker healing
